test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 9 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Study the given graph and answer the question that follows.

The graph presents the total number of candidates who qualified for medical entrance examination from three reputed institutions over the six years.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9bfad8555883afed5530328960017246e99a17500f6cb3cb43af9bfe67261ab3.png] 

In which year have the maximum number of candidates succeeded in all three institutes taken together?
solution:
**Given:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9bfad8555883afed5530328960017246e99a17500f6cb3cb43af9bfe67261ab3.png] 

**Calculation:**

Number of candidates in year 1 = 425 + 645 + 645 = 1715

Number of candidates in year 2 = 523 + 634 + 354 = 1511

Number of candidates in year 3 = 142 + 735 + 142 = 1019

Number of candidates in year 4 = 453 + 153 + 453 = 1059

Number of candidates in year 5 = 243 + 153 + 534 = 930

Number of candidates in year 6 = 534 + 645 + 645 = 1824

Note that the maximum number of candidates is in year 6.

**∴ Option 4 is the correct answer.**
